تكوسجت (form IIq)
# تَكَوْسَجْتُ (takawsajtu) /ta.kaw.sad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# تَكَوْسَجْتَ (takawsajta) /ta.kaw.sad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# تَكَوْسَجْتِ (takawsajti) /ta.kaw.sad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# تَكَوْسَجَتْ (takawsajat) /ta.kaw.sa.d
